name: Conflict check
summary: Checks the parties on a new client or matter against the practice's existing contacts before it opens, and queues opening a clear lead as a matter for approval. Crons read and queue; a person approves every change to a live record.

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New leads (enquiries) from the practice system.

crons.name: check
crons.summary: Read the parties on each new lead and search the contacts for name matches.

crons.name: open-matter
crons.summary: Queue opening each lead with no name matches as a matter, for approval.

draft_ops_note: Every draft operation is a read. The crons write nothing to the platform; their only writes go to the workflow store.

smokeball.covers: lead list, parties on a matter, related parties, contact name search, open a lead as a matter

gaps: Actionstep: the platform evidence describes a conflict check, but the kit has no Actionstep platform and no mapped operations, so it is not built here.

Smokeball's docs describe no conflict check, party list, ethical wall, client notice, recheck or conflict register. The name search in this workflow is our own match against Smokeball contacts, not Smokeball's conflict engine. Confirm the search covers what the practice needs on a sandbox account.
Smokeball is spec status and tested offline only. It needs a sandbox account before any cron runs against a real practice.

No partner sign-off or decline is recorded by this workflow. The runtime has no decision entry point, so a partner reviews name matches in Smokeball and approves the open-matter queue item. Recording a decline needs a core addition.
Ethical walls, client notice for managed conflicts and periodic rechecks are judgment steps and are not automated.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
